items.t: Automatic transmission loses forward gears
items.job: Rebuild or replace automatic transaxle with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: A used transaxle is the cheapest route. Get a firm quote after diagnosis.

items.t: Water pump leak or failure and overheating
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant
items.note: RepairPal lists about $650-$1,100 total, depending on year and engine.

items.t: Check engine light from clogged EGR passages
